boot.failed: The library could not be opened.

sidebar.noDevices: Pair a device to browse its music here.
sidebar.firstPlaylistBody: Drag songs onto a playlist in this list to add them.

status.onlineHelp: Paired devices that are connected right now

home.emptyBody: Add a folder of music or a few files. Songs play straight from your disk, untouched.
home.dropHint: You can also drop files or folders anywhere in this window.

empty.likedBody: Click the heart on any song to save it.
empty.recentBody: Songs you listen to for a few seconds show up here.
empty.playlistBody: Right-click songs and choose Add to playlist, or drag them onto it in the sidebar.
empty.deviceBody: This device is offline or has not shared any songs.
empty.libraryBody: Add a folder or files to fill your library.

playlist.name: Name
playlist.deleteBody: The playlist is removed. Your songs stay in the library.
playlist.exposureDefault: Default for local songs added here

player.idle: Pick a song to start listening
player.toggleRemaining: Switch between total and remaining time

now.nothingBody: Pick a song, or let the whole library surprise you.
now.noLyricsRemote: Lyrics are only read from files on this computer
now.lyricsHint: Put a .lrc file with the same name next to the song, or embed lyrics in its tags.

queue.title: Queue
queue.missing: This song is no longer in the library
queue.emptyHint: Songs you add with Play next or Add to queue appear here. Drag songs here to queue them.
queue.randomHint: The next song is picked at random from all music.

search.placeholder: What do you want to play?
search.noResultsBody: Check the spelling, or search titles, artists, albums and lyrics with fewer words.

toast.exposed: Paired devices can now play these songs
toast.hidden: These songs are no longer exposed
toast.restartNeeded: Saved. Restart the app to use the new database.

notice.offlineTrack: The device that has this song is offline, or the song is not on this computer.
notice.nothingPlayable: Nothing here can be played right now.
notice.playbackFailed: This song could not be played.
notice.incognitoStopped: Incognito is on, so playback from other devices stopped.

file.missing: The file is gone from disk.
file.unreadable: The file can't be read. Check its permissions or whether the drive is connected.

playback.decodeFailed: The file is damaged or can't be decoded.
playback.unsupported: This format isn't supported by the system player.
playback.allSourcesFailed: No device could play this song.

metadata.failed: Tags could not be read; the file name is used instead.

problems.title: Problems
problems.help: Songs that could not be read or played. Fix the file or the folder permissions, then rescan.
problems.accessHelp: Moved, deleted, or on a drive that is not connected.
problems.playbackHelp: The file is there but the system player could not decode it. Playing it again retries the same file.
problems.noneBody: No missing or broken files in your library.

devices.name: Device name
devices.nameHelp: Shown to nearby and paired devices.
devices.pairingHelp: Send this text to your other computer and paste it there under Pair with text. It contains no music or file names.
devices.noPaired: No paired devices yet. Turn on discovery in Settings, or pair with text below.
devices.removeBody: It can no longer sync with this computer or play its music until you pair again.
devices.discoveryOff: Discovery is off. Turn it on in Settings to find computers on this network.
devices.noNearby: Looking for computers running this app on your network…
devices.manualHelp: Enter the IPv4 address and port of the other computer, as shown on its Devices page.
devices.pasteHelp: Paste the pairing text from the other computer.
devices.networkOff: All network features are off. This computer is not reachable.
devices.incognitoOff: Incognito is on. Discovery, sync and sharing are paused.

manual.badText: That pairing text is not valid.

relay.badId: The relay device ID is not valid

offer.title: Pair with this device?
offer.body: {{name}} wants to pair with this computer.
offer.help: Check that both screens show the same safety number before you confirm.

conflict.body: {{feature}} changed on {{device}}, and this computer has changes that weren't synced.

move.title: This song's file changed
move.body: “{{title}}” has new contents. Move its likes and playlist entries to the new version?

download.needFolderBody: Downloaded songs are saved there and added to your library.

drop.title: Drop to add music
drop.body: Folders and audio files are added to your library.

sync.globalHelp: Applies to every row; rows can still differ
sync.blockManualHelp: This computer can't overwrite others with Sync or Refresh. Manual syncs from others still apply here.
sync.blockSourceHelp: Don't follow the chosen device automatically, on LAN or through the relay.
sync.blockTimestampHelp: Recently Played only: don't send or receive the UTC merge.
sync.blockAllHelp: Stop syncing out and stop following. Manual syncs from others can still come in.
sync.sendBody_one: This computer's copy replaces the one on {{count}} online device.
sync.sendBody_other: This computer's copy replaces the one on {{count}} online devices.

settings.playbackHelp: Songs play from the original file without transcoding. Sound goes to the system's default output device.
settings.noFolders: No folders or files added yet.
settings.removeFolderBody: {{path}} is removed from the library. Nothing is deleted from disk.
settings.showUnavailableHelp: List songs from offline devices in the library and search, dimmed.
settings.exposeDefaultHelp: Whether songs that don't belong to a playlist are offered to paired devices.
settings.exposureHelp: Applied once, when a local song joins this list. Changing it later doesn't touch songs already here.
settings.exposeNowHelp: To change songs already here, use Expose all or Stop exposing all.
settings.problemsHelp: Files that can't be reached or failed to play.
settings.historyCapHelp: Older entries are dropped. Between 1 and 10000.

historyModeHelp.utc: Lists from all devices merge by play time (UTC).
historyModeHelp.overwrite: Use Sync below to replace the list on other devices with this one.
historyModeHelp.follow: Pick a device below; this computer follows its list.

settings.incognitoHelp: Nothing is added to Recently Played, and discovery, sync, relay and sharing pause.
settings.networkIncognito: Incognito is on. These switches apply again once it is off.
settings.discoveryHelp: Find and announce on the local network (mDNS). Shares only the device name, never song names.
settings.syncEnabledHelp: Exchange liked songs, playlists, queue, history, theme and language with paired devices.
settings.audioShareHelp: Let paired devices see and play the songs you expose.
settings.positionSyncHelp: When you pause or switch songs, paired devices can resume from the same spot.
settings.relayHelp: Connect to paired devices outside your network through your own relay. All four fields are required.
settings.relayIdHelp: The relay's certificate ID, so this computer only talks to your relay.
settings.syncHelp: With no device chosen, a feature stays on this computer until you press Sync. Choose a device and every online computer follows it.
settings.syncOffNote: Sync data is off in Network, so nothing below is sent or received.
settings.downloadFolderNone: Not set. You'll be asked on the first download.
settings.lanPortHelp: 0 picks a free port. Listening on {{port}} now.
